import math
import unittest

from solution import UNSET, build_connection_options, normalize_timeout


class TimeoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unset_uses_validated_default(self):
        self.assertEqual(normalize_timeout(), 10.0)
        self.assertEqual(normalize_timeout(UNSET, 2), 2.0)
        self.assertIsInstance(normalize_timeout(UNSET, 2), float)

    def test_explicit_none_means_unlimited(self):
        self.assertIsNone(normalize_timeout(None))
        self.assertIsNone(normalize_timeout(None, "unused invalid default"))

    def test_numeric_values_and_boundaries(self):
        for value, expected in ((0, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0), (5, 5.0), (2.5, 2.5)):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                result = normalize_timeout(value)
                self.assertEqual(result, expected)
                self.assertIsInstance(result, float)

    def test_invalid_timeout_values(self):
        for value in (True, "1", [], -1, -0.5, math.inf, -math.inf, math.nan):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    normalize_timeout(value)

    def test_default_is_validated_only_when_used(self):
        for default in (None, UNSET, True, "10", -1, math.inf, math.nan):
            with self.subTest(default=default):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    normalize_timeout(UNSET, default)
        self.assertEqual(normalize_timeout(3, "ignored"), 3.0)
        self.assertIsNone(normalize_timeout(None, UNSET))

    def test_connection_options_defaults_none_and_freshness(self):
        first = build_connection_options()
        second = build_connection_options()
        self.assertEqual(first, {"connect": 10.0, "read": 30.0})
        self.assertEqual(second, first)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        first["connect"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(second, {"connect": 10.0, "read": 30.0})
        self.assertEqual(build_connection_options(None, 0), {"connect": None, "read": 0.0})
        self.assertEqual(build_connection_options(1.5, None), {"connect": 1.5, "read": None})

    def test_connection_options_propagates_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_connection_options(True, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_connection_options(1, math.inf)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
